title: Isolation of extracellular vesicle RNA from bile
protocol: Collect bile into a sterile collection bottle.
Centrifuge sample at 3,000g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer supernatant into 1 ml aliquots in microcentrifuge tubes.
Store supernatant at 4°C or -20°C for long-term storage (> 2 days).
Thaw the stored sample and filter using a 0.20 μm filter prior to RNA isolation.
Transfer 200 µl of bile into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 60 µl Lysis Solution BF, vortex for 5 seconds, incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Add 20 µl Protein Precipitation Solution BF, vortex for 5 seconds, incubate for 1 minute at room temperature.
Centrifuge the sample at 11,000g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer clear supernatant to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Add 270 µl Isopropanol to the supernatant, vortex for 5 seconds.
Assemble the miCURY RNA Mini Spin Column BF in a new collection tube and load the entire sample onto the column.
Centrifuge at 11,000g for 30 seconds at room temperature; discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 700 µl Wash Solution 2 BF to the column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 30 seconds at room temperature; discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 250 µl Wash Solution 2 BF to the column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 2 minutes at room temperature; discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 50 µl rDNase directly onto the membrane of the spin column.
Close lid and incubate for 15 min at room temperature.
Add 100 μl Wash Solution 1 BF to column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 30 sec at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 700 μl Wash Solution 2 BF to column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 30 sec at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 250 μl Wash Solution 2 BF to column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 2 min at room temperature.
Transfer spin column into a new collection tube.
Add 50 μl RNase free H2O directly onto the membrane of spin column.
Close lid and incubate for 1 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 11,000g for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard spin column and store purified RNA at -70°C.
Transfer 200 μl of bile into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 700 μl QIAzol Lysis Reagent, vortex for 5 sec, incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Add 140 μl chloroform, shake vigorously for 15 sec, incubate for 3 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge sample at 12,000g for 15 min at 4°C.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Add 500 μl 100% Ethanol, mix by pipetting.
Assemble RNAeasy Mini Column in a new collection tube and load entire sample onto column.
Centrifuge sample at 8,000g for 15 sec at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 700 μl Buffer RPE to column.
Centrifuge at 8,000g for 15 seconds at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 500 μl Buffer RPE to column.
Centrifuge at 8,000g for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Centrifuge column at 8,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature to dry membrane.
Transfer spin column into a new collection tube.
Add 30 μl RNase free H2O directly onto the membrane of spin column.
Close lid and centrifuge for 1 minute at 8,000 x g at room temperature.
Discard spin column and store purified RNA at -70°C.
Transfer 200 µl of bile into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 40 µl ExoQuick-TC to the sample and mix well.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Centrifuge sample at 13,000 rpm for 2 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and add 140 µl Lysis Buffer to pellet.
Vortex for 15 seconds and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add 80 µl 100% Ethanol to the sample, vortex for 10 seconds.
Assemble Spin Column in a new collection tube and load entire sample onto column.
Centrifuge sample at 13,000 rpm for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 400 µl Wash Buffer to column.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 1 minute at room temperature.
Add 400 µl Wash Buffer to column.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Centrifuge column at 13,000 rpm for 2 min at room temperature to dry membrane.
Transfer spin column into a new collection tube.
Add 30 µl Elution Buffer directly onto the membrane of spin column.
Close lid and centrifuge at 2,000 rpm for 2 min at room temperature.
Increase speed and centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard spin column.
Store purified RNA at -70°C.
